sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "login_account" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "status_reason" TEXT NULL, "connected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "user_agent" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "status_reason" TEXT NULL, "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), "track_stories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("track_stories" IN (0, 1)), "track_posts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("track_posts" IN (0, 1)), "track_reels" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("track_reels" IN (0, 1)), "posts_watermark_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "login_account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES login_account (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_stories_check_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_posts_check_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_new_story_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_new_post_at" INTEGER NULL, "history_range" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE', "history_since" INTEGER NULL, "history_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDLE', "history_cursor" TEXT NULL, "history_fetched" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "history_oldest_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "history_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "highlights_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("highlights_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_check_outcome" TEXT NULL, "last_check_code" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("platform", "remote_user_id"), CHECK (track_stories + track_posts + track_reels >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES target (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shortcode" TEXT NULL, "post_type" TEXT NULL, "posted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "location_name" TEXT NULL, "tagged_usernames" TEXT NULL, "slide_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_close_friends" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_close_friends" IN (0, 1)), "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "viewed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("viewed" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("target_id", "kind", "remote_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_file" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "slide_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "content_uri" TEXT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("content_id", "slide_index"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "check_run" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "result" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NULL, "targets_checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "new_items" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_code" TEXT NULL, CHECK (scope IN ('STORIES', 'POSTS')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES target (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "check_run_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES check_run (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "payload_json" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "governor_lease" ("login_account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "holder" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tokens" REAL NOT NULL, "last_refill_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "backoff_until" INTEGER NULL, "backoff_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, PRIMARY KEY ("login_account_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_content_kind_posted_at ON content (kind, posted_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_content_target_kind_posted_at ON content (target_id, kind, posted_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_check_run_scope_started_at ON check_run (scope, started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_event_at ON activity_event (at DESC)
